verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a 'self-improving database' workflow where agents review production Insights and Schema Recommendations and open performance PRs on a recurring schedule. Service tokens authenticate the hosted MCP server for CI and headless agents, and webhooks (with auth headers and backup events) plus daily scheduled backups support event-driven and scheduled background work. However, the autonomous agent runs on external AI coding tools connected through MCP rather than as a native PlanetScale automation feature, so extra tooling is required. Missing for 10: a first-party built-in automation/scheduler for agent tasks, in-depth setup docs for the recurring workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
